NONE: › someone who makes a judgment, solves an argument, or decides what will be done
仲裁人，公斷人，裁決人；權威人士

example: the arbiters of fashion/taste
時尚／鑒賞權威
The government will be the final arbiter in the dispute.
政府將對爭端作出最終裁決。

NONE: › the method on the stock exchange of buying something in one place and selling it in another place at the same time, in order to make a profit from the difference in price in the two places
套利；套匯；套購
› a person who makes money from arbitrage
從事套利活動的人；套匯者；套購商
C2 based on chance rather than being planned or based on reason
任意的；隨機的；隨心所欲的
› disapproving using unlimited personal power without considering other people's wishes
專斷的；武斷的；霸道的

example: Did you have a reason for choosing your destination or was it arbitrary?
你根據甚麼選擇目的地？還是隨意選定的？
an arbitrary ruler
專制的統治者
The company has been the subject of an arbitrary take-over.
這家公司被強行接管。

NONE: › to make a judgment in an argument, usually because asked to do so by those involved
（通常指在爭議方要求下）仲裁，裁決，公斷

example: I've been asked to arbitrate between the opposing sides.
對立的雙方請我作個公斷。
An outside adviser has been brought in to arbitrate the dispute between the management and the union.
局外顧問受邀對資方和工會之間的爭端進行仲裁。

NONE: › the process of solving an argument between people by helping them to agree to an acceptable solution
仲裁

example: Both sides in the dispute have agreed to go to arbitration (= to have the disagreement solved by an arbitrator).
爭議雙方都同意提請仲裁。

NONE: › a person who has been officially chosen to make a decision between two people or groups who do not agree
仲裁人；裁決人；公斷人
› of or living in trees
樹木的；生活在樹上的，樹棲的

example: Humans evolved from arboreal ancestors.
人類的遠祖是樹棲動物。

NONE: › a large garden where many types of tree are grown, for people to look at and to be studied for scientific purposes
（供科學實驗或教育用的）植物園
› a type of Italian rice with short, fat grains
艾保利奧米（義大利產的圓穀粒稻米）
› a sheltered place in a garden formed by trees and bushes that are grown to partly surround it
（花園中長滿藤蔓的）棚架，藤架，涼亭

example: a rose arbour
爬滿薔薇的涼亭
